title: B13, a well-tolerated inhibitor of hedgehog pathway, exhibited potent anti-tumor effects against colorectal carcinoma in vitro and in vivo.
authors: Wu, Huanxian; Zhang, Lishun; Chen, Boyu; Ou, Baofang; Xu, Jiahuan; Tian, Nannan; Yang, Danni; Ai, Yangcheng; Chen, Qianqing; Quan, Dongling; Zhang, Tingting; Lv, Lin; Tian, Yuanxin; Zhang, Jiajie; Wu, Shaoyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Hedgehog通路抑制剂B13对结直肠癌的抗肿瘤作用，虽涉及Smo蛋白分子对接，但核心是药物活性与肿瘤治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Abnormal activation of Hedgehog (Hh) signaling pathway mediates the genesis and progression of various tumors [1]. Currently, three drugs targeting the Hh signaling component Smoothened (Smo) have been marketed for the clinical treatment of basal cell tumors or acute myeloid leukemia. However, drug resistance is a common problem in those drugs, so the study of Smo inhibitors that can overcome drug resistance has important guiding significance for clinical adjuvant drugs. MTT assay, clone formation assay and EdU assay were used to detect the proliferation inhibitory activity of the drugs on tumor cells. The effect of B13 on cell cycle and apoptosis were detected by flow cytometry. An acute toxicity test was used to detect the toxicity of B13 in vivo, and xenograft tumor model was used to detect the efficacy of B13 in vivo. The binding of B13 to Smo was studied by BODIPY-cyclopamine competitive binding assay and molecular docking. The effect of B13 on the expression and localization of downstream target gene Gli1/2 of Smo was investigated by Western Blot and immunofluorescence assay. Smo(D473H) mutant cell line was constructed to study the effect of B13 against drug resistance. (1) B13 had the strongest inhibitory activity against colorectal cancer cells. (2) B13 can effectively inhibit the clone formation and EdU positive rate of colon cancer cells. (3) B13 can block the cell cycle in the G2/M phase and cell apoptosis. (4) B13 has low toxicity in vivo, and its efficacy in vivo is better than that of the Vismodegib. (5) Molecular docking and BODIPY-cyclopamine experiments showed that B13 could bind to Smo protein. (6) B13 can inhibit the protein expression of Gli1, the downstream of Smo, and inhibit its entry into the nucleus. (7) B13 could inhibit the expression of Gli1 in the HEK293 cells with Smo(D473H), and the molecular docking results showed that B13 could bind Smo(D473H) protein. B13 with the best anti-tumor activity was screened out by MTT assay. In vitro, pharmacodynamics experiments showed that B13 could effectively inhibit the proliferation and metastasis of colorectal cancer cells, induce cell cycle arrest, and induce cell apoptosis. In vivo pharmacodynamics experiments showed that B13 was superior to Vismodegib in antitumor activity and had low toxicity in vivo. Mechanism studies have shown that B13 can bind Smo protein, inhibit the expression of downstream Gli1 and its entry into the nucleus. Notably, B13 overcomes resistance caused by Smo(D473H) mutations.
abstract_zh: Hedgehog (Hh) 信号通路的异常激活介导了多种肿瘤的发生与发展[1]。目前，已有三种靶向Hh信号组分Smoothened (Smo) 的药物上市，用于基底细胞瘤或急性髓系白血病的临床治疗。然而，耐药性是这些药物普遍存在的问题，因此，研究能够克服耐药的Smo抑制剂对临床辅助用药具有重要指导意义。采用MTT法、克隆形成实验和EdU实验检测药物对肿瘤细胞的增殖抑制活性。通过流式细胞术检测B13对细胞周期和凋亡的影响。采用急性毒性实验检测B13在体内的毒性，并利用异种移植瘤模型检测B13在体内的药效。通过BODIPY-cyclopamine竞争性结合实验和分子对接研究B13与Smo的结合情况。采用Western Blot和免疫荧光实验研究B13对Smo下游靶基因Gli1/2表达和定位的影响。构建Smo(D473H)突变细胞系以研究B13对抗耐药的作用。(1) B13对结直肠癌细胞具有最强的抑制活性。(2) B13能有效抑制结肠癌细胞的克隆形成和EdU阳性率。(3) B13能阻滞细胞周期于G2/M期并诱导细胞凋亡。(4) B13在体内毒性较低，其体内药效优于Vismodegib。(5) 分子对接和BODIPY-cyclopamine实验表明B13能与Smo蛋白结合。(6) B13能抑制Smo下游Gli1的蛋白表达，并抑制其进入细胞核。(7) B13能抑制Smo(D473H)的HEK293细胞中Gli1的表达，分子对接结果显示B13能与Smo(D473H)蛋白结合。通过MTT法筛选出具有最佳抗肿瘤活性的B13。体外药效学实验表明，B13能有效抑制结直肠癌细胞的增殖和转移，诱导细胞周期阻滞，并诱导细胞凋亡。体内药效学实验表明，B13在抗肿瘤活性方面优于Vismodegib，且体内毒性较低。机制研究表明，B13能结合Smo蛋白，抑制下游Gli1的表达及其进入细胞核。值得注意的是，B13能克服由Smo(D473H)突变引起的耐药性。
